status_definitions.reported: The original authors or repository state the claim.
status_definitions.reproduced: Public artifacts were rerun with materially matching results.
status_definitions.replicated: An independent implementation supports the same conclusion.
status_definitions.contradicted: A controlled result conflicts with the claim.
status_definitions.open: Available evidence does not decide the claim.

relation_definitions.direct_candidate: Persistent self-modification or self-improvement is a central object of the work.
relation_definitions.precursor: The work isolates a capability likely to matter for RSI but does not by itself establish recursive self-improvement.
relation_definitions.adjacent: The work optimizes AI programs, prompts, workflows, or scaffolds and is a necessary comparator, but self-improvement of the optimizer is not established.
relation_definitions.evaluation: The work primarily supplies evaluation, sandboxing, accounting, or comparison infrastructure.

systems.name: STOP
systems.central_question: Does the improved improver transfer beyond its bounded task setting and remain superior under matched compute and stronger base-model baselines?

systems.name: Promptbreeder
systems.central_question: Does self-referential prompt evolution produce transferable improvement rather than domain-specific prompt fitting, and does the mutation process itself become a better improver?

systems.name: Gödel Agent
systems.central_question: Which self-modifications transfer across tasks and models, and how much measured gain is supplied by the fixed base model, evaluator, and repeated benchmark access?

systems.name: SICA
systems.central_question: Do code-level improvements discovered on the agent's own benchmark persist on time-separated tasks and stronger models after equalizing search and evaluation cost?

systems.name: ADAS
systems.central_question: Does automated agent design transfer across task families and model strengths under equal compute, and what is gained by self-reference beyond a fixed outer designer?

systems.name: AFlow
systems.central_question: Does workflow optimization produce reusable gains outside the optimization benchmark, and does recursively applying the optimizer improve the optimizer itself or only its target workflow?

systems.name: GEPA
systems.central_question: How much reflective program optimization remains after matched rollout budgets and held-out transfer tests, and when does it become reusable self-improvement rather than external optimization?

systems.name: AgentBreeder
systems.central_question: Which scaffold changes transfer beyond the search objective, and what does multi-objective evolutionary search add beyond ordinary external agent optimization?

systems.name: Darwin Gödel Machine
systems.central_question: Does open-ended lineage search produce descendants with higher transferable improvement potential than simpler parent-selection and best-first baselines under matched cost?

systems.name: HGM
systems.central_question: Can predicted lineage potential select branches that yield greater future transferable gain rather than merely exploit noisy estimates of current fitness?

systems.name: HyperAgents
systems.central_question: Does meta-level self-reference improve later optimization across unrelated tasks, and does that advantage persist over multiple generations under matched evaluation budgets?

systems.name: AIDE²
systems.central_question: Can the reported multi-generation gains be independently reproduced, and does the improved research agent continue to generate better descendants on hidden and time-forward AI-R&D tasks?

systems.name: RRSI
systems.central_question: How much of the reported out-of-distribution harness gain survives independent reruns, future task slices, different evaluators, and stronger base models under equalized compute?

systems.name: Meta-Harness
systems.central_question: Does unrestricted source-level harness modification outperform strong restricted optimizers after equalizing proposal, execution, and evaluation cost, and does the resulting harness transfer?

systems.name: HSI
systems.central_question: Do changes to the meta-level improvement procedure transfer to a second improvement problem and increase later descendant quality rather than only current-task fitness?

systems.name: ACE
systems.central_question: When does evolving external context produce durable cross-task capability gain, and how does that gain compare with weight updates and ordinary retrieval under equal memory and inference budgets?

systems.name: EvoHarness-RL
systems.central_question: Does learned harness construction transfer beyond the reported environment and persist across task distributions, or primarily internalize task-specific runtime state management?

systems.name: SPIN
systems.central_question: How far can iterative self-play improve model weights before gains saturate or self-generated data narrows the training distribution, especially as the base model becomes stronger?

systems.name: Self-Rewarding Language Models
systems.central_question: Does jointly improving task behavior and self-evaluation remain reliable when the model exceeds the quality of its initial external feedback, and how are reward errors prevented from compounding?

systems.name: SEAL
systems.central_question: Does self-edit generation remain beneficial across model scale, task shift, and repeated generations, and can the successor improve the update process rather than only its task policy?

systems.name: OpenRSI
systems.central_question: Are model and system gains additive, synergistic, or benchmark-coupled when all four model-harness component combinations are evaluated on untouched tasks?

systems.name: MASS
systems.central_question: Which capabilities improve or regress when model and workflow are updated together, and do either component's gains survive cross-version swaps and domain shift?

systems.name: SIA
systems.central_question: Does the controller learn which system object should change on unseen tasks, or is update selection tied to the evaluator and task distribution used during development?

systems.name: RSI-Anything
systems.central_question: Can an improvement strategy learned through environment feedback transfer across structurally different environments without exploiting a learned world model or evaluator?

systems.name: Dream-RSI
systems.central_question: When does simulated rehearsal predict real improvement on unseen tasks rather than exploit simulator errors, and does a better policy subsequently become a better improver?

systems.name: ScienceBuddy
systems.central_question: Which reported gains survive outside the scientific tasks and evaluators used during improvement, and how much is attributable to model change versus harness change?

systems.name: RSIGym
systems.central_question: Which evaluation protocols reliably distinguish reusable system improvement, benchmark adaptation, evaluator exploitation, and simple substitution of additional compute?
